name: CNGR Advanced Material Co., Ltd.
summary: CNGR Advanced Material Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces and sells new battery materials such as ternary precursors, cobaltosic oxide, iron phosphate, LFP, sodium-ion precursors and lithium carbonate. These serve 3C digital products, power batteries and energy storage, and the company operates in China, Europe, America and elsewhere.
